name: danwo-example-ai-chat
description: A support assistant on Next.js and the AI SDK: it looks up orders and opens tickets from Postgres, emails through Resend, and is tested against scripted and faulted model answers.

scripts.matrix: danwo matrix tests/deterministic.danwo.ts --grep "opens a ticket for a broken mug" --thorough --budget 60
scripts.matrix:plan: danwo matrix tests/deterministic.danwo.ts --grep "opens a ticket for a broken mug" --thorough --budget 60 --plan
scripts.matrix:order: danwo matrix tests/deterministic.danwo.ts --grep "looks up an order" --thorough --budget 60
